sourceText:
My Apple Coffee Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:05am

Ingredients




1 cup Butter
1 cup Sugar
2 Eggs
1/2 teaspoon Vanilla
2 cups Flour
1 teaspoon Baking soda
1 teaspoon Baking powder
1 cup Sour cream (light or yogurt)
1/2 cup Brown sugar
 cup Nuts
4 tablespoons White sugar
1 teaspoon Cinnamon
2 Apples, peeled & sliced

Preparation

1 Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream. Put half of batter in pan. Lay apple slices on batter and sprinkle 1/2 of topping over them. Add remaining batter and sprinkle topping on it. Bake in 350 oven 35-40 minutes.
